comparison.objective: Align and fasten a DIN rail to a plate with two loose screws; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Align rail slots, start loose screws, and drive each into fixed holes; candidate holds an adjustment screw while tightening its concentric jam nut so the setting does not rotate.
comparison.success_condition: Both independent fasteners tight through aligned slots versus one adjustable stop locked near 90°, drift-limited, and verified over three cycles.
comparison.reason: This is the closest requested threaded-tool task, but it tests screw starting and structural fastening rather than preserving a calibrated setting against locknut reaction.
